title: DORA Register of Information Structure Builder
description: Build and validate your DORA Register of Information. 24 ESA data quality checks, CIF T1/T2/T3 classification, xBRL-CSV structure export (Markdown), Policy Mandate JSON. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.
